title: OEE and loss-ledger policy
description: Site interpretation of the ISO 22400 time model used by the loss-accounting engine and the KPI engine. Spec KPI01 (S, D, R, U, V with ideal-time weighting and stream boundaries), KPI02 (micro-stops stay in R and reduce P; planned stops inside S reduce A; unknown intervals never counted as running), KPI04 (GE-style reconciled OEE shown separately and labelled), ACC02 (derate component). Decision D04. Consumed by sub-phases 2.5 (engine) and 2.7 (KPIs); versions recorded on every calculation run.

plannedStopsInsideScheduleReduceAvailabi.description: Stops inside planned production time (planned maintenance, changeovers) reduce availability; only time genuinely outside the production schedule is excluded, through calendar exclusions (SME 2026-10-13, EXPERT_REVIEW Q6). Time model: S = scheduled time after calendar exclusions, D = availability stops inside S. False would move planned stops out of S, which D04 only allows through explicit calendar exclusions.

derateComponent.description: OEE component charged for reduced-rate (derate) running (ACC02). `availability` means a fractional availability loss.

overlapAllocation.description: How overlapping stops share time (SME 2026-10-13, EXPERT_REVIEW Q11: allocate each loss once by a stated rule): equal_share splits each overlapping segment equally between the causes; first_out gives it to the cause that started first. Absent = equal_share.

transitionAllowanceInPlan.description: LA-08 (ISO 22400 / GE PLA common practice, 2026-10-14): whether the plan target already allows for grade transitions within their approved standard. planned = the campaign plan deducts the standard transition time, so the planned rate is target / (eligible time - standard transition time) and the plan ledger has no transition_allowance line (only transition_excess explains the gap; the allowance is reported on the plan totals as planned transition time). loss = the plan does not deduct it, so the allowance is a plan-ledger loss line. The capacity ledger shows allowance and excess either way. Absent = loss (versions written before the option); new versions default to planned.

microStopSeconds.description: Stops shorter than this stay in R and reduce P (performance); stops >= this are availability stops in D (KPI02, DT03). Must equal `state_rules.body.microStopSeconds` for the same scope; the engine refuses a run when they differ.

microStopSecondsByAssetClass.description: SME D6 (2026-10-14): micro-stop threshold per asset class (the asset's asset type, compared without case), overriding microStopSeconds for stops whose first event names an asset of that class; e.g. 120 s pilot for operator-cleared bagger / conveyor stops, 0 for a reactor (every trip is an event). Absent = microStopSeconds for every stop.

tripReasonCodes.description: SME D6: reason codes of process trips. A stop coded with one, or carrying a functional failure (failure severity critical / degraded), is an availability event whatever its length, never a micro-stop. Absent = none.

stopEvents.description: Plan 1.10 / DT-04 / SME D5 (2026-10-15): stop events from the unit state engine and duplicate / repeat handling. Every field optional; absent = the pilot default.

deriveFromState.description: Derive downtime events from the unit's mapped state signal (internal stop, planned stop, starved, blocked, standby). Unknown time is never a stop.

debounceSeconds.description: DT02: a stop occurrence shorter than this is chatter (no event).

restartConfirmSeconds.description: DT02: running shorter than this between two stop samples is not a restart.

duplicateToleranceSeconds.description: DT-04: two overlapping stops of one unit / asset whose starts (and ends, when both closed) differ by at most this are one stop recorded twice.

autoMergeDuplicates.description: Merge a unique cross-source duplicate without cause conflict automatically (keep the timing authority, the other as evidence, reversible); false = suggest only.

incidentWindowSeconds.description: SME D5: stops of one asset and reason starting within this after the previous one ended form one incident (counted once in MTBF; durations per stop).

idealTimeWeighting.description: KPI01: U and V are ideal production times (quantity / sustained rate) summed over product and rate segments, so multi-product periods weight by ideal time rather than averaging percentages.

maxUnknownShare.description: If unknown_time / S exceeds this share the OEE factors are reported with quality `provisional` (and `unavailable` when no good/gross evidence exists) instead of `ok` (KPI02, KPI03). 0 = any unknown time makes the KPI provisional.

reconciledOeeTileEnabled.description: Show the GE-style reconciled OEE (from G, LA, LP, LQ) as a separately labelled tile next to operational OEE (KPI04, D04).

streamCombinationRule.description: How KPIs for concurrent product streams on one unit are reported (KPI01 last sentence, AN03). Combined values are produced only from compatible denominators (same S policy and declared stream boundary); otherwise `unavailable` with reason.

defaultLedgerView.description: Both ledgers are always computed (ACC01); this picks the ledger the period UI opens on (D04).
